note: No public queryable parcel service found for Tensas Parish (FIPS 22107) after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web. The Tensas assessor has no public web parcel portal, per the state tax-records directory. The clerk's record search (cotthosting) requires a subscription login. The only parcel sources found are commercial (Regrid, Acres, Dynamo, landrecords.us). A LandGrid Louisiana parcel FeatureServer exists but returns 'Token Required'. The Tensas_Parish_WFL1 service holds redistricting and roads layers, not parcels. The Regrid nationwide tile service exposes no query endpoint.
